Snapoly background music

Controlled Groove.mp3 and Digital Arpeggio.mp3 were supplied by Nathan in
the existing local Mobile/PolySnap/Music folder on 26 October 2026.
The packaged files preserve those supplied MP3 bytes under URL-safe filenames.
No authorship or license beyond the user's supplied provenance is asserted here.
Music playback is capped at 20% volume and has an independent mute control.
